Once again I gave this game a chance, and unsurprisingly I am as disappointed as I was the first time I bought it. You see, I pre-ordered this doo doo on console, and unlike its predecessors, I couldn't get through it more than twice. Sitting through the contrived personalities and substandard dialogue is teeth-grindingly excruciating. 

The plot is so boring that I'd sooner tell you that Mount & Blade, a series with no plot, has a better plot! This wouldn't be the case if your dialogue choices felt like they really made a difference, but most of the time the dialogue feels mismatched, out of place, and lacking any consequence whatsoever. Sure, you still get a hollow shell that tries to represent the illusion of choice, but that's all it is, a mere husk of a concept. 

Pros for the game:
-Boobs
-Combat mechanics are pretty cool
-Multiplayer APEX missions are decent enough

Cons for the game:
-Everything I haven't already mentioned
-Especially the microtransaction system for multiplayer (reward vs. time spent playing ratio is egregious for many new players) 
-Facial animations are still hilariously unreal (wiggle them eyebrows for me, girl, yeah)

Get it on a sale, dedicate yourself to multiplayer, and maybe, just maybe you'll get through the plot more than once.

I bought this game knowing about the bad facial expressions that still exists and the drama at launch. But I have to say I had a blast of a time! The combat in this game is by far the best in the Mass effect series. You don’t feel limited by cover anymore and it feels more fluid. (At least with my melee/ bionics build.) I heard the story was bad, but I liked the adventure. They tried to copy some Star trek TNG stories, but it does not have the same emotional punch as those. This game lets you run a first contact event which is one of my biggest dreams since watching Star Trek for the first time. If you have the same dream and like fast non cover based combat, then give it a try! 

[i]For those who are worried this game has a good ending and does not leave you with any huge cliffhangers.[/i]

My single complaint is the character creation. It's very bad and it's very hard to make an attractive character. Took me hours to make a decent character!
A fine game, and worth exploring.
